description: Official-split data pipeline, vocabulary regeneration, probe hardening, and the optional fail-closed OpenHands warm-start — all CI-testable with fixtures/synthetic data (no multi-GB download, no GPU). Depends on FEAT-001 (build_graph_features, DecoupledGCN) and FEAT-002 (official-split train plumbing it must align with). Implements design sections 7.1 (prepare_include two-tree split), 6.3 (sync_vocabulary + three-way order test), 2.0/3.1 (probe preset-parse hardening), 4 (import_openhands_weights warm-start + minimum-match acceptance gate).
steps: training/prepare_include.py: add --split-csv-train / --split-csv-test (CSVs extracted from the GitHub include_metadata.zip, NOT the Zenodo Train_Test_Split.zip). Before any join, assert the CSV header is byte-exactly 'Category,Word,Video,FilePath' in that order; abort loudly naming the file on mismatch. Build a case- and extension-insensitive join key (Category, Word-folder, Video-stem) with clean_label stripping the 'NN. ' prefix; match on-disk clips to CSV rows. Emit TWO feature trees features/train/<label>/<stem>.npz and features/test/<label>/<stem>.npz built with build_graph_features, plus a 'split' column in manifest.csv. Add a count-reconciliation guard: every CSV row with no on-disk match AND every on-disk clip in neither CSV is logged and a non-zero count FAILS the run. Build label_map.json from the sorted union of labels across both trees. Fix the stale '--model holistic_landmarker.task' docstring example to --pose-model/--hand-model.

tools/sync_vocabulary.py (NEW): regenerate config/vocabulary.json from a trained label_map.json in class-index order, emitting EXACTLY {note, signs:[{label,category,demo}]} where label is byte-identical to the label_map key, category comes from the split-CSV join when available else the literal 'include50' (never null/missing), demo:false for all entries. Must stay readable by recognize.py::_vocab_labels (data['signs'] then s['label']).

tools/probe_openhands_assets.py: harden the 27-node preset check — PARSE the preset list out of the fetched pose_transforms.py source into a list of ints and compare it to EXPECTED['preset_27'] (semantic value comparison), keeping the raw-text marker check only as a secondary signal. A value mismatch still fails safe into drift.

tools/import_openhands_weights.py (NEW, optional/off critical path, 263-class only, gated behind a flag): download include_slgcn.zip; extract the .ckpt with a pytorch_lightning.*-stubbing unpickler shim (NO Lightning install); FIRST verify the .ckpt is a torch zip whose top-level pickle references only stubbable pytorch_lightning.* modules (else fall back to random init, never block). Remap key names to DecoupledGCN; load_state_dict(strict=False); then apply the minimum-match acceptance gate: accept ONLY if warmstart_loaded_fraction = 1 - len(missing_keys)/len(model_state_dict) >= 0.90 AND every graph-conv + temporal-conv weight tensor (enumerated explicitly from the module tree) matched by name AND shape; otherwise log at WARNING, discard the partial load, re-init random, set warmstart_loaded_fraction=0.0. Record warmstart_loaded_fraction + the conv-shape check pass/fail in the run metadata and echo to stdout.

Add tests: core/tests/test_prepare_include_join.py (header assertion rejects a non-matching header; join-key normalization matches 'Animals/4. Bird/MVI_2987.MOV'-style rows to on-disk stems case/extension-insensitively; the two output trees are path-disjoint); core/tests/test_sync_vocabulary.py (schema {note,signs:[{label,category,demo}]}, category falls back to 'include50', demo false, AND a three-way order test asserting [s['label'] for s in vocabulary['signs']] == manifest.labels == list(label_map keys in index order) element-for-element); core/tests/test_warmstart_guard.py (a deliberately-partial remap triggers fallback-to-random with warmstart_loaded_fraction==0.0; a complete remap is accepted with fraction>=0.90 and the conv-shape check passing — exercised with synthetic state_dicts, NO network).
acceptance_criteria: Running `c:\Users\ABHIMAN KUMAR\Documents\GitHub\Signtalk-AI\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest core/tests server/tests -q` passes all new tests and keeps the 48 existing ones green.
prepare_include.py rejects a Zenodo-style/mismatched CSV header loudly before any join.
The three-way label-order invariant holds element-for-element (vocabulary.json == manifest labels == label_map index order).
The warm-start gate falls back to random init (fraction 0.0) on an incomplete remap and only accepts a >=90% + conv-shape-matched load.
The probe's preset check compares parsed int values, not an exact-spacing substring.

findings:
IMPLEMENTED (branch feat/gcn-recognizer). Exact CLI flags/paths FEAT-004 needs:

=== training/prepare_include.py (rewritten; legacy + official modes) ===
LEGACY single-tree (default, vector build_features): `python training/prepare_include.py --include-root <dir> --out-dir <dir> [--pose-model models/pose_landmarker.task] [--hand-model models/hand_landmarker.task] [--fps 30.0] [--vocab-only]`.
OFFICIAL two-tree split (graph build_graph_features, [T,27,2]): add `--split-csv-train <train_include50.csv> --split-csv-test <test_include50.csv>` (BOTH required together; supplying one alone aborts). CSVs are the GitHub include_metadata.zip ones (NOT Zenodo Train_Test_Split.zip). Outputs features/train/<label>/<stem>.npz + features/test/<label>/<stem>.npz, manifest.csv with columns [clip,label,split,status,reason,n_frames,hands_pct], and label_map.json over the sorted union of labels.
GUARDS: header asserted byte-exactly ['Category','Word','Video','FilePath'] (SystemExit naming the file on mismatch); join key = (Category.lower, clean_label(Word).lower, Path(Video).stem.lower) via `join_key()` — case+extension-insensitive; clean_label strips 'NN. '. Count-reconciliation: any CSV row with no on-disk clip OR any on-disk clip in neither CSV -> logged + non-zero count raises SystemExit (fails the run). Stale '--model holistic_landmarker.task' docstring example replaced with --pose-model/--hand-model.
Public test-callable helpers: _assert_csv_header, _read_split_csv, join_key, discover_clips, clean_label.

=== tools/sync_vocabulary.py (NEW) ===
`python tools/sync_vocabulary.py --label-map <label_map.json> [--out config/vocabulary.json] [--split-csv <train_include50.csv>]`.
Emits EXACTLY {note, signs:[{label,category,demo}]} in class-INDEX order (NOT re-sorted). label byte-identical to label_map key; category from split-CSV Category column when --split-csv given else literal 'include50' (never null/missing); demo:false for all. Stays readable by recognize.py::_vocab_labels (data['signs'] -> s['label']). Public helpers: load_label_map (returns labels ordered by int index), load_category_lookup, build_vocabulary.

=== tools/probe_openhands_assets.py (hardened; still uncommitted design artifact, now committed) ===
Preset-27 check now PARSES the int list out of the fetched pose_transforms.py via `parse_preset_27(source)->list[int]|None` (find marker 'mediapipe_holistic_minimal_27', first [...] literal, read ints) and compares BY VALUE to EXPECTED['preset_27']. report['preset_27'] now has keys {status,marker_present,parsed_preset,values_match}; a value mismatch still appends to drift (fail-safe). Raw marker substring kept only as secondary signal.

=== tools/import_openhands_weights.py (NEW, optional, 263-class, fail-closed) ===
`python tools/import_openhands_weights.py --num-classes 263 --warmstart --download [--ckpt <path>] [--out models/decoupled_gcn_warmstart.pt] [--meta runs/warmstart_meta.json] [--work-dir runs/warmstart_tmp]`.
Without --warmstart: stays random init, writes meta with fraction 0.0. With --warmstart but no --download/--ckpt or an unsafe/unreadable ckpt: random init, reason recorded. Download URL = AI4Bharat OpenHands release include_slgcn.zip. verify_and_extract_state_dict() checks the .ckpt is a torch zip and loads under a pytorch_lightning.*-stubbing shim (_install_lightning_stubs, NO Lightning install); returns None (->random init) if structure differs. remap_openhands_keys() strips model./encoder./model.encoder. and maps decoder.->classifier.
ACCEPTANCE GATE `apply_warmstart_gate(model, remapped)->meta` (pure, unit-testable): feeds only name+shape-matching tensors to load_state_dict(strict=False) (strict=False still raises on shape mismatch of a PRESENT key, so misshapen keys are filtered and counted as not-loaded). warmstart_loaded_fraction = 1 - len(missing_keys)/len(model_state_dict). Accept ONLY if fraction>=0.90 (WARMSTART_ACCEPT_FRACTION) AND conv-shape check passes. Conv weights enumerated by MODULE TYPE (not substring) via `enumerate_conv_weight_names(model)`: for each DecoupledGCNUnit -> '<prefix>.linear_weight' + '<prefix>.decoupled_A'; for each TCNUnit -> '<prefix>.conv.weight' (10 layers each). On reject: WARNING log, re-init random (_reinit_random calls every module.reset_parameters), fraction forced 0.0. meta keys: warmstart_loaded_fraction, conv_shape_check_passed, accepted, num_model_tensors, num_missing_keys, num_unexpected_keys, conv_failures.

core/tests/test_prepare_include_join.py (6): header rejects mismatch/reorder; accepts exact; join_key case+ext-insensitive; _read_split_csv builds keys from FilePath; two trees path-disjoint.
core/tests/test_sync_vocabulary.py (3): schema {note,signs:[{label,category,demo}]} + category fallback 'include50' + demo False; category from split CSV; three-way order invariant vocab==label_map-index-order==manifest-labels-in-index-order (uses deliberately non-alphabetical index map {Hello:0,Alright:1,Thank you:2}).
core/tests/test_warmstart_guard.py (4): conv names cover all 10 layers; complete remap accepted fraction==1.0; partial remap rejected fraction==0.0; conv shape mismatch rejected fraction==0.0.
